blocks.text: 今天在 6.2 Sol/Astra 上，网红和普通用户之间氛围差异的一个有趣原因是，我们不久前给了少数人访问权限，然后在过去 3-4 天里做了很多改动，我很确定这几天内没有重新测试，而视频是上周制作的。

blocks.text: 别误会，虽然这些模型相比它们的 GPT 前代是巨大的飞跃，但它们绝非完美，团队也很期待模型在未来的迭代中在品味和使用体验上变得更好。喜欢所有的反馈，我们听到了！

blocks.text: One of the funny reasons for the difference in vibes between the influencers and the crowd today on 6.2 Sol/Astra is that we gave a few folks access a while ago and then made a lot of changes in the last 3-4 days and I'm pretty sure no re-testing was done within those days and the videos were produced last week.

blocks.text: Don't get me wrong, while the models are a hefty jump compared to their GPT predecessors, they are by no means perfect and there are a few things the teams are excited for the models to get better at in future iterations in terms of taste and niceness of use. Love all the feedback and we hear you!
